attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the cluster's internal NTP source (chrony local reference clock, stratum 10, serving 10.100.93.0/24) and node2 as a chrony client pointed solely at node1 (no public NTP servers). Verified sync working, then restarted both nodes one at a time, confirming boot-id changes and post-reboot recovery of the internal time-sync relationship.
